lines.zh: 我用肉鳍划水，慢悠悠的。
lines.en: I paddle with my fleshy fins, unhurried.
I swim close to the bottom.
I turn clumsily.

lines.zh: 我嘴里塞得下什么，就吞。
lines.en: Whatever fits in my mouth, I swallow.
My tail sweeps steadily.

lines.zh: 我的鳞擦过粗糙的岩面。
lines.en: My scales scrape the rough rock.
Waterweed drags over my scales.
I follow a shoal of small fish.
I rise a little, then sink.
I swim over a stretch of mud.
I patrol along the bank.
I'm thinking only of eating.
I paddle along with my fleshy fins.
The water is murky, so I follow scent.

lines.zh: 我钻到倒下的树干下面。
lines.en: I slip under a fallen trunk.
I circle in the shallows.
My fins have grown strong.
I head into deeper water.
I press into the rock crack and wait for food.
My fins stir slowly.
I'm waiting for the next thing I can swallow.
Something smells here.
There's nothing in my mouth.
My scales are hard and very old.
I can't see very far.
Mouth open, I wait for the water to bring food.
I want another mouthful.
I carry a heavy smell of mud.
This pool is too small.
I wait for something to fall in.
My belly has swollen a little.

lines.zh: 我把身体摆到顺水的方向。
lines.en: I set my body with the current.
Your reflection enters the water first.
You're on the bank; I'm on the bottom.
Swimming toward you, mouth open.
Are you eating something?
My mouth is big; I swallow anything.

lines.zh: 你脚下的东西能给我吗？
lines.en: Could I have what's at your feet?
I'm close; don't move.
You stand on the riverbed, stirring mud.
My mouth hasn't closed at all.
The water's murky; I only smell iron.
I bolt and the water clouds.

lines.zh: 我掉了几片鳞，肉鳍还撑着。
lines.en: A few scales came off; my fleshy fins still hold.
I turn, mouth still open.
I slip into a rock hollow and hide.
My gills are working faster.
I steady myself on the bottom.
I flick my fins and swim on.
I look that way again.
The smell of my blood tightens my fins.

lines.zh: 我用肉鳍划水，拐弯特别笨。
lines.en: I row with my fins and turn awkwardly.
That thing is sinking.
That little thing goes down in one gulp.
I swim toward it slowly.

lines.zh: 这点分量，连牙缝都填不满。
lines.en: This much won't even fill the gaps between my teeth.
I smell meat.
I open my mouth and wait for it to drop in.
My belly is moving.
Drop a little more in.
Does this thing move?
I swallowed too fast.
Your boot kicks up a cloud of sand.
I tip over into a clump of weeds.
My scales are slippery.
Mud boils up from the bottom.
I swim away from your legs.
I bounce off and spin once.
I wobble, then steady myself.
My fin has been torn.

lines.zh: 我吞得下什么，就长多大。
lines.en: Whatever I swallow, I grow to match.
Stop splashing.
Another comes out of the mud.

lines.zh: 两条鳍在石缝边碰了一下。
lines.en: Our fins touch once by the crack in the stone.
Its fins are wider than mine.
We circle the same stone.
Their eggs are on the bottom.
Our fins simply touch.
We just stay together.
Once we've eaten, we part.
This pool can sustain them.
I swim slowly away.
I open my mouth and swallow.

lines.zh: 我吞得下比自己大的东西。
lines.en: I can swallow things bigger than me.

lines.zh: 它在我的喉咙里卡了一下。
lines.en: It caught in my throat for a moment.
I take the whole thing in.
I don't even chew.
Too big; I spit it out.
Half a fish is still stuck in my mouth.
I drag it into deeper water.
After swallowing, I'm heavier.
My belly is still empty.
Anything that fits my mouth, I chase.
I swing my tail and ease closer.
It's smaller than my mouth.
I aim my mouth that way.
I've fixed on that scent.

lines.zh: 我摆尾一压，就溜到它背后。
lines.en: One push of my tail and I slip behind it.
I swallow anything and grow.
I turn broadside and block the crevice.

lines.zh: 我什么都吞，肚子越来越大。
lines.en: I swallow anything; my belly grows.
I'm right beneath it.
I go along the bottom.
I move forward with my mouth open.
Water passes my gills.
I see its tail moving.
I'm in no hurry; I close in slowly.
I line my mouth up with it.
It moved.
Half a block closer.
My fins stir up the mud.
One gulp, and I grow a little.
I swallow it whole.
My jaws close.
Whatever fits my mouth, I swallow.
I slap with a fin.
I ram it into the rock.
I got a mouthful of mud.
I open wide and bite the water.
I open my mouth again.
It got out.
My belly swells.
I paddle out of the mud.
This pool is shallow.
First I circle once.
My fins leave marks in the mud.

lines.zh: 我这张嘴吞得下任何东西。
lines.en: These jaws will swallow anything.
I open my mouth and test it.
Sunlight reaches into the water.
I swim into the deep.
This fish is very old.
I bite at whatever I find.
I swim out from deep in the rocks.
Anything that fits my mouth goes down.
Fire on the surface sends me deeper.

lines.zh: 我从水里被掀上岸，拍打不停。
lines.en: I'm thrown onto the bank and slap about.

lines.zh: 水太浅了，我的鳃干得发疼。
lines.en: The water is too shallow and my gills burn dry.

lines.zh: 水底炸开，我被冲得翻过来。
lines.en: The blast under water flips me over.

lines.zh: 箭扎进我的背鳍，水都浑了。
lines.en: The arrow struck my dorsal fin and the water clouded.
That light stiffens my fins.

lines.zh: 我饿得发慌，见什么咬什么。
lines.en: I'm frantic with hunger and bite at anything.

lines.zh: 雷落进水里，我整条一颤。
lines.en: Lightning hits the water and my whole body jolts.

lines.zh: 水忽然没了，我张着嘴往下掉。
lines.en: The water is suddenly gone and I fall, mouth open.
